03-violin-plot-orchestra.visual_critic_note: Intentional Tol Bright palette (not defaults), clear typographic hierarchy, smart split-violin encoding with semantic city ordering — held back from 8 by tropical-city violins collapsing to near-horizontal dashes at cell size and the median legend line being nearly invisible on the light background.
03-violin-plot-orchestra.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest: data-driven y-scale via d3.extent, global maxDensity normalization enables cross-cell density comparison, Silverman bandwidth selection, linear violin width correctly encodes density (not a lie-factor violation), and no dual-axis or truncated baseline issues; minor robustness gap is that removing an outlier could shift maxDensity and alter all violin widths simultaneously.
03-violin-plot-orchestra.stress_test_note: Fully static violin plot with tooltip-only pointer events; no brush, zoom, or transitions eliminates Update Storm, Stale Scale, and Mid-Flight Snap risks, and the unified Pointer Events API (pointerenter/pointermove/pointerleave) correctly avoids mouse-touch double-firing.
03-violin-plot-orchestra.cognitive_load_note: 72-cell grid (6 cities × 12 months) is managed well as a pattern — 2-color palette reads instantly, shared y-scale enables cross-row comparison, and row-dimming on hover prevents simultaneous overload; the only weakness is that median lines are hard to see at the small cell size.
